scenarios.name: MEAN_REVERTING
scenarios.description: Deterministic oscillation around the starting price.

scenarios.name: FLASH_MOVE
scenarios.description: Abrupt downward move followed by partial recovery.

scenarios.name: ORACLE_DISLOCATION
scenarios.description: One external oracle diverges while normal policy decides the outcome.

scenarios.name: REFERENCE_DEGRADATION
scenarios.description: Primary external oracle is unavailable; fallback consensus is exercised.

scenarios.name: POSITIVE_FUNDING_STRESS
scenarios.description: Elevated positive funding with otherwise orderly prices.

scenarios.name: NEGATIVE_FUNDING_STRESS
scenarios.description: Elevated negative funding with otherwise orderly prices.

scenarios.name: LIQUIDITY_SHOCK
scenarios.description: Order-book depth collapses temporarily without synthetic fill probability.
